pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding positions within 15 minutes of a prior entry or during high ATR expansion wicks to prevent averaging down into falling knives.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory multi-timeframe liquidity sweep confirmation and 5-period EMA slope alignment before order placement.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% at +$10.00, trail remaining position with a tight structural stop to capture asymmetric +$15.00 to +$30.00 runs.
